name: Low-Life Bar Owner (Human Rogue 4)
source: The War of the Goblin King
book: The War of the Goblin King

body:
Low-Life Bar Owner

CR 3

XP 1,200
Male human rogue 4
N Medium humanoid (human)
Init -1; Senses Perception +6

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 12, flat-footed 16 (+4 armor, +1 Dex, +1 dodge)
hp 25 (4d8+4)
Fort +1, Ref +5, Will +1
Defensive Abilities evasion, trap sense +1, uncanny dodge

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee masterwork dagger +4 (1d4/19-20) and masterwork dagger +4 (1d4/19-20)
Special Attacks sneak attack 2d6
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 4th; concentration +5)

3/day—mage hand
2/day—charm person (DC 14)

STATISTICS

Str 11, Dex 13, Con 10, Int 18, Wis 11, Cha 13
Base Atk +3; CMB +3; CMD 14
Feats Dodge, Two-Weapon Fighting, Weapon Finesse, Weapon Focus (dagger)
Skills Acrobatics +8, Bluff +7, Climb +7, Disable Device +8, Escape Artist +8, Intimidate +7, Knowledge (local) +11, Perception +7, Sense Motive +7, Sleight of Hand +8, Stealth +8, Swim +7, Use Magic Device +7
Languages Common, Dwarven, Infernal, Undercommon
SQ rogue talent (major magic), rogue talent (minor magic)
NPC Gear +1 studded leather, masterwork dagger (2), wand of unseen servant (50 charges)
